header: Title: Plain Egg | worked in spiral rounds
text:
Plain Egg
US crochet terms used throughout.
Worked in continuous spiral rounds.
Round 1 - 5 sc in magic ring. You should have 5 sts
Round 2 - *sc inc; rep from * 4 more times. You should have 10 stitches
Round 3 - *sc in the next st, sc inc* around. You should have 15 sts
Round 4 - Sc in the next st, sc inc, *sc in each of the next 2 st, sc inc; rep from * 3 more times, sc in the next st. You should have 20 stitches
Round 5 - *sc in each of the next 3 st, sc inc; rep from * 4 more times. You should have 25 stitches
Round 6 - *sc in each of the next 4 st, sc inc* around (you should have 30)
Round 7 - Sc in each of the next 30 st. You should have 30 stitches
Round 8 - *sc in each of the next 4 st, dec; rep from * 4 more times. You should have 25 sts
Round 9 - *sc in each of the next 3 st, dec; rep from * 4 more times. You should have 20 stitches
Round 10 - *sc in each of the next 2 st, dec; rep from * 4 more times (you should have 15)
Round 11 - *sc in the next st, dec* around. You should have 10 sts
Round 12 - *dec* around. You should have 5 sts
Fasten off, weave the tail through the front loops and pull tight.

header: Title: Wavy Placemat
text:
Wavy Placemat
US crochet terms used throughout.
Foundation: ch 13
Row 1 - SC in 2nd CH from hook, SC in each CH across (you should have 14)
Row 2 - CH 1, turn, SC in the next st, HDC in the next st, DC in each of the next 10 st, HDC in the next st, SC in the next st. You should have 14 sts
Row 3 - CH 1, turn, SC across
Row 4 - CH 1, turn, SC in the next st, HDC in each of the next 3 st, DC in each of the next 6 st, HDC in each of the next 3 st, SC in the next st. You should have 17 stitches
Row 5 - CH 1, turn, SC across (you should have 14)
Row 6 - CH 1, turn, SC in each of the next 3 st, HDC in the next st, TR in each of the next 6 st, HDC in the next st, SC in each of the next 3 st. You should have 14 sts
Rows 7-8 - CH 1, turn, SC across
Row 9 - CH 1, turn, SC in each of the next 2 st, HDC in each of the next 2 st, DC in each of the next 6 st, HDC in each of the next 2 st, SC in each of the next 2 st (you should have 14)
Row 10 - CH 1, turn, SC across
Fasten off and weave in ends.

text:
Chunky Party Hat

Work in a spiral; do not join rounds.
Materials: worsted weight yarn, 4 mm hook, stuffing, tapestry needle.

Round 6 - *sc in each of the next 2 st, 2 sc in next st; rep from * 2 more times (you should have 12).
Rounds 7-8 - Sc in each st around (you should have 12).
Round 9 - *sc in each of the next 2 st, 2 sc in next st; rep from * 2 more times. You should have 15 sts.
Rounds 10-11 - Sc in each st around (you should have 15).
Round 12 - Rep (sc in each of the next 4 st, 2 sc in next st) around. You should have 18 sts.
Round 13 - Sc in each st around (you should have 18).
Round 14 - *sc in each of the next 5 st, 2 sc in next st; rep from * 2 more times (you should have 21).
Rounds 15-16 - Sc in back loops only in each st around. You should have 21 stitches.

text:
Pocket Cactus
US crochet terms used throughout. Worked in joined rounds.
Abbreviations: sc = single crochet, inc = 2 sc in the same st, dec = sc2tog.

Round 4 - Ch 1, single crochet in each st around, join with a sl st. You should have 18 sts.
Round 5 - Ch 1, sc in each st around, sl st to join (you should have 18).
Round 6 - Ch 1, single crochet in each st around, join with sl st to first sc (you should have 18).
